# Alkali v0.2.2 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [Alkali](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Alkali](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.md): Public API for Static Site Generator.
- [Alkali.Application](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.md): Application layer boundary for the Alkali static site generator.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.BuildCacheBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.BuildCacheBehaviour.md): Behaviour defining the build cache interface.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.CollectionRendererBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.CollectionRendererBehaviour.md): Behaviour for collection page rendering operations.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.ConfigLoaderBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.ConfigLoaderBehaviour.md): Behaviour defining the configuration loader interface.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.CryptoServiceBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.CryptoServiceBehaviour.md): Behaviour for cryptographic operations.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.FileSystemBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.FileSystemBehaviour.md): Behaviour defining the file system interface.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.FrontmatterParserBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.FrontmatterParserBehaviour.md): Behaviour for frontmatter parsing operations.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.LayoutResolverBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.LayoutResolverBehaviour.md): Behaviour defining the layout resolver interface.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.MarkdownParserBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.MarkdownParserBehaviour.md): Behaviour for markdown parsing operations.
- [Alkali.Application.Behaviours.RssRendererBehaviour](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Behaviours.RssRendererBehaviour.md): Behaviour for RSS feed rendering operations.
- [Alkali.Application.Helpers.Paginate](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.Helpers.Paginate.md): Paginate helper module for splitting collections into pages.
- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.BuildSite](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.BuildSite.md): BuildSite use case orchestrates the full static site build process.
- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.CleanOutput](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.CleanOutput.md): CleanOutput use case handles deletion of the build output directory.
- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.CreateNewPost](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.CreateNewPost.md): CreateNewPost use case creates a new blog post with frontmatter template.

- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.GenerateCollections](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.GenerateCollections.md): GenerateCollections use case creates collections of pages grouped by tags and categories.
- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.GenerateRssFeed](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.GenerateRssFeed.md): GenerateRssFeed use case creates an RSS feed for blog posts.
- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.ParseContent](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.ParseContent.md): ParseContent use case parses markdown files and creates Page entities.

- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.ProcessAssets](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.ProcessAssets.md): ProcessAssets use case processes static assets (CSS, JS, binary files),
minifies them, generates fingerprints, and tracks mappings.

- [Alkali.Application.UseCases.ScaffoldNewSite](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Application.UseCases.ScaffoldNewSite.md): ScaffoldNewSite use case creates a new static site with example content.
- [Alkali.Domain](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.md): Domain layer boundary for the Alkali static site generator.
- [Alkali.Domain.Entities.Asset](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Entities.Asset.md): Asset entity represents a static asset file (CSS, JS, or binary).
- [Alkali.Domain.Entities.Collection](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Entities.Collection.md): Collection entity represents a group of pages (by tag or category).
- [Alkali.Domain.Entities.Page](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Entities.Page.md): Page entity represents a single page or blog post.
- [Alkali.Domain.Entities.Site](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Entities.Site.md): Site entity represents site configuration.
- [Alkali.Domain.Policies.FrontmatterPolicy](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Policies.FrontmatterPolicy.md): FrontmatterPolicy defines business rules for validating frontmatter.
- [Alkali.Domain.Policies.SlugPolicy](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Policies.SlugPolicy.md): SlugPolicy defines business rules for generating URL-safe slugs.
- [Alkali.Domain.Policies.UrlPolicy](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Domain.Policies.UrlPolicy.md): UrlPolicy defines business rules for generating URLs from file paths.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.md): Infrastructure layer boundary for the Alkali static site generator.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.BuildCache](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.BuildCache.md): Manages build cache for incremental builds.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.ConfigLoader](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.ConfigLoader.md): Loads site configuration from config/alkali.exs file.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.CryptoService](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.CryptoService.md): Infrastructure service for cryptographic operations.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.FileSystem](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.FileSystem.md): Infrastructure service for file system operations.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.LayoutResolver](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.LayoutResolver.md): Resolves and renders layouts for pages.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.Parsers.FrontmatterParser](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.Parsers.FrontmatterParser.md): Frontmatter parser for extracting YAML metadata from markdown files.

- [Alkali.Infrastructure.Parsers.MarkdownParser](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.Parsers.MarkdownParser.md): Markdown parser with basic HTML conversion.

- [Alkali.Infrastructure.Renderers.CollectionRenderer](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.Renderers.CollectionRenderer.md): Infrastructure renderer for collection pages.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.Renderers.RssRenderer](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.Renderers.RssRenderer.md): Infrastructure renderer for RSS feed generation.
- [Alkali.Infrastructure.Renderers.TemplateRenderer](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Alkali.Infrastructure.Renderers.TemplateRenderer.md): Template renderer using EEx.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix alkali.build](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Alkali.Build.md): Builds the static site from content files.
- [mix alkali.clean](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Alkali.Clean.md): Removes the build output directory (_site by default).
- [mix alkali.new](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Alkali.New.md): Creates a new static site with starter templates and example content.
- [mix alkali.new.post](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Alkali.New.Post.md): Creates a new blog post with frontmatter template.
- [mix alkali.post](https://alkali.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Alkali.Post.md): Creates a new blog post with frontmatter template.
